critique_closures.evidence: The opening now conditions reciprocal-mean divergence on bounded gradients and predicted decreases tending to zero, agreeing with Theorem 2.

Global opening and post-benchmark history are shorter; the former Section 6.7 is replaced by a transition; the 449-word synthesis carries the distinct regimes and unresolved boundaries once. Further optional local tightening is not necessary for satisfaction.

critique_closures.status: optional change deliberately not taken; not a blocker
critique_closures.evidence: The explicit scalar interpolation remains in the main text. It is mathematically complete and visibly readable. Moving it would mainly redistribute pages, not cure an actual defect; retaining it is reasonable.
Introduction names the example in Theorem 9. Proof headings read Proof (Theorem 7), Proof (Theorem 10), Proof (the algebraic part of Lemma 4), and Proof (Proposition 1), without duplicate Proof.

Lewis–Overton and Bogosel citations are grammatically integrated. The stable-manifold passage cites Dyatlov 2018 v1, Section 3.5 Theorem 3 and Remark 4; Section 3.1, expressly after adapted splitting and rescaling.

The conclusion is shorter, formal verification is supporting rather than the plot, substantive AI assistance and human review/consent status remain explicit, and the extraneous administrative inventory is removed.

opening_and_closing_coherence.assessment: Title and abstract match the positive/negative scope. The first two pages identify the question, three contribution axes, primary lineage and exact mixed benchmark before detailed contributions finish on page 3. The synthesis returns to the benchmark and broader mechanisms, keeps the negative regularity regimes distinct, and preserves the finite strongly convex C2 and probabilistic/semialgebraic boundaries. Formal verification and AI assistance follow the scientific conclusion.

figures_and_tables.assessment: Both figures and all three tables remain legible, contained and accurately qualified. Trial-table and figure placement on page 25 makes the query geometry easier to consult. No extra figure or table is needed.

layout.checks: No clipped text, overlaps, unreadable glyphs, broken displays/tables, unresolved reference marks or displaced equation numbers observed. Proofs spanning pages remain readable; complete reference list fits on page 46.

retained_optional_choice: N03 interpolation placement kept as an editorial choice, not an unresolved proof obligation.
